summary: Keyword co-occurrence in utility file without traced installer harm
details: Static keyword co-occurrence (a 'ping' reference and 'GET' tokens) matched in lib/Utils/generics.js of a Baileys fork. No credential-path reads (~/.aws, ~/.ssh, ~/.npmrc, browser stores), no hardcoded attacker C2 destination, no install-time or import-time fetch-and-execute path, no lifecycle scripts running network operations, and no exfiltration of installer data are present in the traced code. The pattern matches on primitives commonly present in the underlying Baileys library (HTTP GETs to WhatsApp media/CDN endpoints, connectivity checks) rather than a hostile shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
